headline: Assam CM to lead BJP’s November 1 padyatra in Shimla: Rajeev Bindal
content: Shimla, Oct 28 (PTI) Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma will lead the ‘Loktantra Bachao Arajakta Hatao’ rally in Shimla on November 1, Himachal Pradesh BJP president Rajeev Bindal said on Wednesday. Addressing a press conference here, Bindal said the BJP will organise four major padyatras across Himachal Pradesh. The first padyatra will take place in Dharamshala on October 30 under the leadership of MP Dr Rajeev Bhardwaj and former Assembly Speaker Vipin Singh Parmar, he said. “The second padyatra will be held in Shimla on November 1, beginning from the Old Bus Stand and proceeding towards Chaura Maidan. The Assam chief minister will participate in the padyatra alongside Leader of Opposition Jai Ram Thakur, MPs Anurag Singh Thakur and Suresh Kashyap, and other senior BJP leaders. BJP state vice-president Bittu Verma will serve as the programme convenor,” he said. One in Mandi, led by Jai Ram Thakur and former minister Suresh Bhardwaj serving as the convenor, and one in Hamirpur, under Bindal’s leadership. “MP Anurag Singh Thakur, senior BJP leader Satpal Singh Satti and other party leaders will participate, while Randhir Sharma will serve as the programme convenor for the padyatra in Hamirpur,” he said.

headline: Goa Pensioners Can Submit Life Certificates at Post Offices or from Home
content: The Department of Posts, Goa Division, in collaboration with India Post Payments Bank (IPPB), will facilitate the submission of Digital Life Certificates (DLC) through the Jeevan Pramaan service across Goa from November 1, 2026. The facility will benefit Central Government, Goa State Government and EPFO pensioners, allowing them to submit their annual life certificates at post offices or from the comfort of their homes. As part of the nationwide Digital Life Certificate 5.0 Campaign, pensioners can visit their nearest post office to complete the process. Those who are unable to travel, including pensioners living in remote areas, can avail themselves of the doorstep service through postmen and Gramin Dak Sevaks. The Digital Life Certificate is generated through Aadhaar-based biometric authentication using fingerprints or face authentication. Once the verification is completed successfully, the certificate is generated digitally, and an SMS confirmation is sent to the pensioner. The certificate is then made available to the concerned Pension Disbursing Authority, making the process convenient and hassle-free. The doorstep facility is available at a nominal charge of ₹70, inclusive of GST, per successfully generated certificate. No additional doorstep delivery charge is applicable. This service helps pensioners avoid travelling to banks or treasury offices and standing in queues to submit their annual life certificates. Pensioners in Goa can request the service through any of the following options: Pensioners should keep their Aadhaar number, registered mobile number, Pension Payment Order (PPO) number or Pension ID, and bank account details ready while requesting the service.

headline: State Level Bankers’ Committee Sikkim Launches Mega Financial Inclusion Saturation Camp at Gangtok
content: The State Level Bankers’ Committee (SLBC), Sikkim, launched a mega Financial Inclusion Saturation Camp today at Chintan Bhawan, Gangtok, as part of the nationwide campaign being organized as per the directives of the Government of India to connect every citizen with basic banking, pension and insurance services. The launching ceremony was graced by Shri G. T. Dhungel, Minister for Health and Family Welfare and Culture Departments, Government of Sikkim, as the Chief Guest. Other dignitaries present on the dais included Shri Tenzing Loden Lepcha, IPS, DIG, CID Department, Government of Sikkim; Shri Manohar Lall, General Manager, NABARD; Shri Sudhir Kanekar, Deputy General Manager, RBI; and Shri Prashant Kumar Singh, Deputy General Manager, SBI. The programme featured key thematic sessions by domain experts. On the topic of Social Security Schemes, Shri Gopal Lama, Assistant General Manager, SLBC, briefed the gathering on the benefits and enrolment processes for various schemes such as PMJDY, PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY, etc. On Cyber Security and Fraud Prevention, Shri Tenzing Loden Lepcha educated the citizens about digital and online frauds and shared essential tips on the prevention of cybercrime. On Safe Banking Practices, Shri Phurba Sherpa, Chief Manager, SBI, highlighted the importance of linking Aadhaar cards to bank accounts, updating KYC details and tracking unclaimed money or assets. On Support for Farmers, Shri Manohar Lall shared details on how farmers can easily avail loans through the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme and protect their crops using the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). On Fraud Prevention and KYC Compliance, Shri Sudhir Kanekar educated the audience on the importance of timely Re-KYC and C-KYC updates and provided a comprehensive overview of the official complaint mechanisms for reporting financial fraud. In his closing remarks, the Chief Guest, Shri G. T. Dhungel, praised the event as highly informative and urged the public to secure their future by enrolling in these government schemes. The AGM, SLBC, informed that the campaign will continue till 31st December, 2026 and will cover all 197 GPUs and ULBs of Sikkim. The programme concluded with a formal vote of thanks by Shri Alok Kumar Das, Regional Manager, SBI. headline: Bank Holiday tomorrow: Open or closed on Karwa Chauth 29 Oct 2026 Thursday?
content: Bank holiday tomorrow: The Reserve Bank of India's official holiday schedule for October 2026 has listed a local holiday for public and private sector banks in one region on account of Karwa Chauth, to be observed on Thursday, 29 October this year.In addition to the common national and gazetted holidays, or weekend offs, banks in India have local holidays and festivals listed on the RBI calendar, as required. Besides this, as per the central bank's rules, all scheduled and non-scheduled banks observe listed holidays and mandatory closure on second and fourth Saturdays and every Sunday in a month. During these days, digital services (online net banking, app) remain operational while in-branch services are shut.The RBI releases its official bank holiday list in January each year. Customers should contact your nearest local bank branch for the confirmed local holiday schedule.Shimla, Himachal holiday on Karwa Chauth 29 Oct Thus, according to the official RBI calendar, all banks in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, including public and private sector lenders the State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Punjab National Bank (PNB), Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda and other more, will remain closed on Thursday, 29 October 2026 for Karwa Chauth. During the week, other holidays to come are as follows: On 31 October (Saturday) in Ahmedabad (Gujarat) for Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birthday; and pan India on 1 November due to Sunday weekend holiday. Online banking, apps to customer rescue on holidays For customers who face urgent requirements or for daily spends, online banking services and bank mobile apps remain operational across the country even on official holidays and the weekends. You can thus use these uninterrupted services for convenient financial transactions.UPI: You can use the respective bank apps or payment platforms to send and receive money round the clock using UPI. Please note that transactions may be affected by glitches or scheduled maintenance work during which the banks will notify you as such.NEFT / RTGS / DD / Cheque: You can use the NEFT or RTGS transfer forms to conduct transfer requests, besides physical demand draft or cheques to make payments.Cards: Customers also have the option to use credit cards, debit cards, and the ATM to conduct transactions.For recurring or scheduled expenses such as bills or recharges, you can set up standing instructions. You can also apply for a bank locker for access to assets.Bank holidays in November 2026Banks will be closed for a total of 16 days next month, including state and regional holidays and weekend offs, as per the official RBI calendar for November.— Weekend offs: November 1, 8, 15, 22, 28, and 29 for Sunday holidays; and November 14 and 28 for second and fourth Saturday holidays, respectively.— Regional holidays: November 9, 10, 11, 13, 16, 20, 23, 24 and 27. Disclaimer: This story is for educational purposes only. Check the official RBI or respective bank websites for bank holiday calendar, alerts and notifications.

headline: Theon Group Expands Its Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Footprint through the Slump Sale Acquisition of Maneesh..
content: Theon Group has expanded its pharmaceutical manufacturing footprint through the Slump sale acquisition of Maneesh Pharma Unit VI in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh.The acquired unit will operate under the name Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. This development marks an important milestone in the Group’s growth journey and reinforces its commitment to expanding manufacturing capabilities and strengthening its presence in the pharmaceutical industry.With an established presence in pharmaceutical manufacturing, Theon Group continues to pursue strategic growth opportunities that support its long-term business objectives. The addition of Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. reflects broadening of its operational capabilities and building a more diversified pharmaceutical manufacturing platform.Located in Baddi, one of India’s prominent pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs, Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. will form an important part of Theon Group’s expansion plans. The acquisition is expected to support the Group’s evolving business requirements and create opportunities to serve customers across domestic and international markets.This development also reflects the Group’s continued commitment to operational excellence, quality-driven manufacturing and long-term customer partnerships. Through strategic investments and the development of its group companies, Theon Group aims to build a strong foundation for sustainable growth.Zoevita holds WHO-GMP certification, as stated in its current company credentials, and has international regulatory approvals or market authorizations associated with the following countries and authorities like Ethiopia (EFDA), Tanzania (TMDA), Uganda (NDA), Uzbekistan, Myanmar, Yemen.The company also positions its operations with reference to USFDA and EU compliance expectations.Zoevita operates a modern manufacturing facility designed to support efficient production, consistent product quality, and growing customer requirements. The facility currently manufactures pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products across three key dosage forms: tablets, capsules, and sachets.It has an annual manufacturing capacity of 3,000 million tablets per year, 150 million capsules per year and 30 million Sachets per yearWith a continued focus on infrastructure development and business expansion, Zoevita is progressing toward the addition of oral liquid manufacturing sections. These planned developments reflect the company's ambition to broaden its manufacturing capabilities and address a wider range of pharmaceutical & nutraceutical market opportunities in India and overseas.About Theon GroupTheon Group is a pharmaceutical business group with diversified capabilities across pharmaceutical manufacturing and generic medicines, supported by its group companies: Theon Pharmaceuticals Ltd., Theon Lifesciences Ltd., and Theogen Pvt. Ltd and now Zoevita Lifesciences LtdTheon Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a leading finished dosage formulation manufacturing company. We are a PIC/S, WHO-GMP, and ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing facility with capabilities for Tablets, Capsules, Oral Suspensions, Dry Powder Injections, Ointments, Creams, and Sachets. We manufacture and market a wide range of high-quality pharmaceutical products and remain committed to delivering quality medicines at affordable prices.Tablets • Capsules • Dry Powder Injection • Ointments & Dry SyrupsManufacturing Capacity (in Millions per annum)General Block -Tablets 1500 MHard Gelatin Capsules 500 MDry Syrup 30 MOintment 30 MPenicillin BlockTablets 750 MHard Gelatin Capsules 250 MDry Syrup 30 MCephalosporin BlockTablets 750 MHard Gelatin Capsules 250 MDry Syrup 30 MCephalosporin BlockDry powder Injection 60 MTheon Pharmaceuticals is currently exporting products to more than 45 countries across various regions, including Africa: Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Asia: Philippines, Cambodia, Myanmar, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Central Asia: Afghanistan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan,Middle East: Iraq, Yemen, Latin America: Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Cuba, Bolivia, Nicaragua, VenezuelaGMP Accreditations: PIC/S, PPB Kenya, TMDA Tanzania, EFDA Ethiopia, FDA Ghana, NDA Uganda, NAFDAC Nigeria, DPM Ivory Coast, FDA Philippines, MOH Myanmar, MOH Sri Lanka, DPV Vietnam, MOH Cambodia, MOH Iraq, MOH Yemen, MOH Afghanistan, MOH Venezuela, MOH Uzbekistan, MACZ Zimbabwe, MOH Swaziland, NDSO Lesotho, MINSA Nicaragua, Ecuador, Cuba, and the Dominican Republic.Theon Lifesciences Limited is our newly established, state-of-the-art sterile manufacturing facility located at Derabassi, Mohali, Punjab, India. Theon Lifesciences Ltd. operates a manufacturing facility designed in accordance with US FDA guidelines and EU-GMP standards with capabilities in liquid injectables, lyophilised (freeze-dried) injectables, ophthalmic preparations, ampoules and vials, supporting the Group’s injectable and specialised pharmaceutical portfolio.Our new facility has been designed and developed in compliance with EU Annexure-1 and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, reflecting our strong commitment towards quality, compliance, and global regulatory standards.The plant has already commenced commercial production and is conveniently located near Chandigarh International Airport. Theon Life Sciences received WHO GMP certificate in the month of May 26, Our PICs audit from Ukraine has already been approved last month.Manufacturing Capabilities• Lyophilized Vials – 30 million vials per annum• Liquid Injection Vials – 120 million vials per annum• Prefilled Syringes (PFS) – 30 million units per annum• Glass Ampoules – 120 million ampoules per annum• Eye/Ear Drops – 30 million bottles per annumSeveral sterile injectable products have already been developed and are being supplied to the Indian domestic market, while many additional products are currently under development. Simultaneously, we are actively working on products for SRA-regulated markets and are targeting EU-GMP, ANVISA, and EAEU audits during 2026.Theogen serves as the marketing arm of Theon Group, focusing on the marketing and commercialisation of generic medicines, expanding market reach, and strengthening the Group’s presence across domestic pharmaceutical markets.Disclaimer: The above content is non-editorial, and TIL hereby disclaims any and all warranties, expressed or implied, relating to it, and does not guarantee, vouch for or necessarily endorse any of the content.

headline: Sukhu inaugurates Rs 200-crore academic block at Hamirpur medical college
content: Shimla: Himachal chief minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu on Tuesday inaugurated the Rs 200-crore academic block at Dr Radhakrishnan Government Medical College, Hamirpur, and launched an Allied and Healthcare College offering four courses with 210 seats.The new college will offer 60 seats each in Bachelor of Medical Lab Science, Bachelor of Radiology and Bachelor of Anaesthesia, besides 30 seats in dialysis. Sukhu said the initiative would strengthen healthcare education and create a skilled workforce to meet the growing demand for specialised medical services. The new academic block is expected to improve medical education infrastructure and access to advanced healthcare facilities in the region.During an interaction with MBBS students, the chief minister said govt would consider increasing the internship stipend. He also highlighted the Dr YS Parmar Vidyarthi Rin Yojna, under which students from families with an annual income of up to Rs 12 lakh can avail loans of up to Rs 20 lakh at 1% interest. He said govt was developing modern facilities at the college, including an amphitheatre, auditorium, library and separate boys’ and girls’ hostels, each with a capacity of 300 students. Plans are also underway for a super-speciality block, cancer hospital, dental college and nursing college. Sukhu said the selection of 10 postgraduate and 10 MBBS students from each state medical college for overseas exposure visits was almost complete. He added that Himachal Pradesh’s postgraduate medical seats had increased from 277 to 597, including 320 additional seats made available this year. At Hamirpur medical college, PG seats have risen from eight to 57.Later, Sukhu inaugurated the Rs 4.30-crore residence complex of the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog and laid foundation stones for a Rs 1.50-crore street food park and a Rs 10-crore child care institution in Hamirpur.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Chandigarh | Silver Rate in Chandigarh | Bank Holidays in Chandigarh | Public Holidays in Chandigarh | Chandigarh AQI | Weather in Chandigarh | Petrol Price in Chandigarh | Diesel Price in Chandigarh | CNG Price in Chandigarh | LPG Price in ChandigarhStay updated with the latest Chandigarh news. headline: Himachal CM Sukhu considers MBBS stipend hike, plans Hamirpur medical college expansion
content: Hamirpur: The Himachal Pradesh government is actively working to enhance the quality of medical education, placing a special emphasis on modern technology and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced on Tuesday. Sukhu expressed this commitment during an interaction with students at Dr Radhakrishnan Government Medical College in Hamirpur. The chief minister also mentioned that the state government is considering increasing the internship stipend for MBBS students [https://news.careers360.com/maharashtra-mbbs-interns-demand-rs-30000-monthly-stipend-3-pc-annual-hike-medical-warn-strike-november-2] and will make the necessary budgetary provisions for this proposed increase In response to a question from an MBBS student about initiatives to develop Government Medical College, Hamirpur, into a leading medical institution, the chief minister highlighted ongoing efforts. When asked by another student about measures to improve safety and infrastructure at the college, Sukhu informed her about the construction of a modern amphitheatre, an auditorium, and a library. Additionally, separate hostels for boys and girls, each with a capacity of 300 students, are also being built. Also read After AMU and Jamia, BHU students launch agitation for union polls, on hold for 3 decades [https://news.careers360.com/bhu-banaras-hindu-university-student-union-polls-nsui-aisa-disha-samajwadi-chhatra-sabha-launch-protest-march-30-years] HAMIRPUR MEDICAL COLLEGE EXPANSION He said that the layout plan for Government Medical College, Hamirpur, has been prepared with the assistance of a Japanese company. Plans are also underway to establish a super-speciality block, a cancer hospital, a dental college and a nursing college at the institution in the future. Research activities will also be encouraged at the college. Sukhu mentioned that the selection process for 10 postgraduate and 10 MBBS students from each of the state's medical colleges is nearly complete. These selected students will soon be sent abroad to study best practices in the medical field.
